title: Tech Lead – Backend (Python / FastAPI / Java)
description: Zeawis Ltd is hiring on behalf of a leading international technology company for an experienced Tech Lead – Backend to lead the development of scalable, enterprise-grade backend systems and AI-powered applications. If you have a strong background in backend architecture, modern cloud technologies, microservices, and AI-assisted software development, this is an exciting opportunity to work with a global engineering team building innovative software solutions. Develop AI-native applications by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases, and AI agent workflows. Implement authentication, authorization, caching, queueing, monitoring, and asynchronous processing. Collaborate with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, DevOps, QA, and AI teams to deliver high-quality software. Review code, mentor backend developers, and establish engineering best practices. Utilize AI-powered development tools for code generation, documentation, testing, debugging, and refactoring while ensuring security, scalability, and maintainability. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 7 years of professional backend software development experience. Proven experience leading or mentoring backend engineering teams. Strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, Microservices, Distributed Systems, and WebSockets. Strong understanding of databases, API security, authentication, authorization, caching, asynchronous processing, and backend architecture. Experience developing enterprise-scale backend applications. Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and the ability to evaluate AI-generated code for accuracy, security, performance, and maintainability. Excellent career growth and learning opportunities. Important This role is intended for highly experienced senior backend engineers. Applicants who do not meet the minimum requirements (7+ years of relevant backend development experience and technical leadership experience) are strongly advised not to apply, as only candidates who closely match the required qualifications will be shortlisted and contacted.
